# King Killers Apparel

A fighter-owned and operated combat-sports apparel brand based in Tampa / St. Petersburg, Florida, USA. Founded in 2021 by professional fighter Michael "Heck" Heckert.

## Brand Identity & Ethos
- **Tagline:** "Real Kings Kill Kings" (representing the mindset of hunting the top competitors).
- **Style Aesthetic:** Gritty, aggressive, and confident design stacks featuring their signature red, white, and black paint-splatter graphics.
- **Made in USA:** Strong emphasis on American-made craftsmanship and support for local athletic communities.
- **Audience:** Built for MMA fighters, BJJ practitioners, boxers, Muay Thai athletes, CrossFitters, and general gym goers.

## Product Offerings
King Killers design and manufacture high-performance athletic apparel ranging in price from $19 to $69. Key products include:
- **Fight & Training Shorts:** 2-in-1 hybrid training shorts, mesh gym shorts, and swim trunks.
- **MMA & BJJ Gear:** High-durability MMA rashguards.
- **Gym Wear:** Graphic tees, tanks, hoodies, and sleeveless hoodies.
- **Accessories & Art:** Hats, boxing-glove necklaces, and combat-sports wall art.

## Trust & Guarantees
- **Customer Rating:** 4.8 out of 5 stars based on 200+ customer reviews.
- **Shipping Policy:** Free shipping on all orders of $100 or more.
- **Return Policy:** 30-day money-back guarantee on all purchases.
- **Fighter Operated:** Owned and designed by active professional fighters who wear-test all gear.

## Online Details
- **Website:** https://kingkillers.co
- **Headquarters:** Tampa / St. Petersburg, Florida, USA
- **Founding Year:** 2021
